dishes.name: Sheet-Pan Chicken and Roots
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Cut the potatoes and carrots into bite-size pieces and toss with half the oil, salt and pepper on a tray.
Rub the chicken with paprika and the rest of the oil, then nestle it among the vegetables.
Roast about 35 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through and the potatoes are golden.

dishes.name: Ginger Chicken Stir-Fry
steps: Start the rice.
Slice the chicken thinly and sear it in hot oil until browned, then set aside.
Stir-fry the broccoli and pepper for 4 minutes, adding garlic and ginger for the last minute.
Return the chicken, add the soy sauce and a splash of water, and toss for 2 minutes. Serve over rice.

dishes.name: Quick Chicken Tacos
steps: Toss sliced chicken with chili powder, cumin and salt.
Cook in hot oil for 8 to 10 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill with chicken, shredded cabbage and cilantro. Squeeze lime over the top.

dishes.name: Lemon Chicken Couscous
steps: Season the chicken and sear it in oil for 6 minutes a side, until cooked through. Rest and slice.
In the same pan, soften the garlic, add the broth and bring to a boil.
Stir in the couscous and spinach, cover, and take off the heat for 5 minutes.
Fluff with lemon zest and juice, then top with the chicken.

dishes.name: Coconut Chicken Curry
steps: Start the rice.
Soften the chopped onion in oil, then add garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add bite-size chicken and brown it lightly.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer 15 minutes. Salt to taste and serve over rice.

dishes.name: Chicken and Pepper Quesadillas
steps: Cook small pieces of salted chicken and sliced pepper in oil until done.
Scatter cheese, chicken and pepper over two tortillas and top with the others.
Toast in a dry pan for 2 to 3 minutes a side, until the cheese melts.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

dishes.name: Smash Burgers and Slaw
steps: Toss shredded cabbage with mayo, vinegar and salt.
Roll the beef into balls and smash them flat in a very hot pan. Season well.
Cook 2 minutes, flip, add cheese and cook 1 minute more.
Toast the buns, build the burgers and serve with the slaw.

dishes.name: Weeknight Bolognese
steps: Finely chop the onion and carrot, then soften them in oil for 6 minutes.
Add the beef and garlic and brown well.
Stir in the tomato paste and canned tomatoes. Simmer 25 minutes.
Boil the pasta, toss with the sauce and season to taste.

dishes.name: One-Pot Beef Chili
steps: Soften the chopped onion in oil.
Add the beef and brown it, then stir in the spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and drained beans.
Simmer 30 minutes, stirring now and then. Salt to taste.

dishes.name: Saucy Beef and Broccoli
steps: Start the rice. Toss the beef with the cornstarch.
Sear the beef in very hot oil for 2 minutes and set aside.
Stir-fry the broccoli with a splash of water for 4 minutes, adding garlic at the end.
Return the beef with both sauces and toss until glossy.

dishes.name: Turkey Lettuce Wraps
steps: Brown the turkey in oil with the garlic.
Stir in the fish sauce and half the lime juice.
Grate the carrot and slice the green onions.
Spoon the turkey into lettuce cups, top with the vegetables and the rest of the lime.

dishes.name: Pork Chops and Green Beans
steps: Season the chops and sear them in oil for 4 to 5 minutes a side, until cooked through. Rest.
Boil the green beans for 4 minutes and drain.
Melt the butter in the pan with the garlic for 1 minute.
Toss the beans in the garlic butter and serve beside the chops.

dishes.name: Sausage and Peppers
steps: Brown the sausages in oil, then take them out.
Cook sliced peppers and onion with oregano and salt for 10 minutes.
Slice the sausages and return them to the pan.
Cover and cook 8 minutes, until the sausages are cooked through.

dishes.name: Bacon Carbonara
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water and save a cup of the water.
Crisp the chopped bacon in a wide pan.
Beat the eggs with the parmesan and lots of pepper.
Off the heat, toss the pasta with the bacon, then the egg mix, loosening with pasta water until creamy. Heat gently if you want the eggs fully set.

dishes.name: Salmon and Tomato Traybake
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Toss the tomatoes and sliced zucchini with the oil and salt on a tray. Roast 10 minutes.
Add the salmon, season, and top with lemon slices.
Roast 10 to 12 minutes more, until the salmon flakes easily.

dishes.name: Miso-Glazed Salmon Rice
steps: Start the rice and heat the broiler.
Stir the miso and honey together and brush over the salmon.
Broil 8 to 10 minutes, until browned and cooked through.
Wilt the spinach in a pan and serve with the rice and sliced green onion.

dishes.name: Crispy-Edge Fish Tacos
steps: Rub the fish with chili powder and salt.
Pan-fry in hot oil for 3 minutes a side, then flake.
Stir lime juice into the sour cream.
Fill warm tortillas with fish and cabbage, then spoon the lime cream over.

dishes.name: Tuna Melts
steps: Mix drained tuna with mayo, finely chopped celery, salt and pepper.
Heat the broiler and toast the bread on one side.
Spread tuna on the untoasted side and top with cheese.
Broil 2 to 3 minutes, until bubbling.

dishes.name: Tomato Tuna Pasta
steps: Boil the pasta.
Warm the garlic and chili in oil for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes, then stir in drained tuna and olives.
Toss with the pasta and salt to taste.

dishes.name: Garlic Shrimp Pasta
steps: Boil the pasta and save a little of the water.
Melt the butter with garlic and chili for 1 minute.
Cook the shrimp for 2 to 3 minutes until pink.
Toss in the pasta, lemon juice and parsley, loosening with pasta water.

dishes.name: Shrimp Fried Rice
steps: Cook the rice and spread it out to cool, or use leftover rice.
Sear the shrimp in oil until pink and set aside.
Scramble the eggs in the pan, add the rice and peas and fry 3 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, shrimp and sliced green onions and toss.

dishes.name: Red Curry Shrimp
steps: Start the rice.
Fry the curry paste in oil for 1 minute, then add the sliced pepper.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer 8 minutes.
Add the shrimp and cook 3 minutes until pink. Finish with lime.

dishes.name: Shakshuka
steps: Soften the chopped onion and pepper in oil for 8 minutes.
Add the spices, then the tomatoes. Simmer 10 minutes.
Make four wells and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook 5 to 7 minutes, until the eggs are done how you like.

dishes.name: Mushroom Spinach Omelette
steps: Cook the sliced mushrooms in butter until browned, then wilt in the spinach.
Beat the eggs with salt and pepper.
Pour half the eggs into a buttered pan and cook gently until nearly set.
Add half the filling and feta, fold and repeat for the second omelette.

dishes.name: Five-Minute-Prep Egg Fried Rice
steps: Cook the rice and spread it out to cool, or use leftover rice.
Scramble the eggs in hot oil.
Add the rice and peas and fry 3 minutes.
Stir in the soy sauce and sliced green onions.

dishes.name: Peanut Tofu Stir-Fry
steps: Start the rice. Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice, chili and a splash of water.
Fry cubes of tofu in oil until golden on most sides, then set aside.
Stir-fry the broccoli for 4 minutes.
Return the tofu, add the sauce and toss until coated.

dishes.name: Spicy Gochujang Tofu
steps: Start the rice.
Soften the garlic in oil, then stir in the gochujang with a half cup of water.
Add cubes of tofu and simmer 8 minutes.
Finish with sesame oil and sliced green onions.

dishes.name: Chickpea Spinach Curry
steps: Start the rice.
Soften the chopped onion in oil, then add garlic and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and drained chickpeas and simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted. Salt to taste.

dishes.name: Lemony Lentil Soup
steps: Soften the chopped onion and carrot in oil.
Add the cumin and rinsed lentils and stir for 1 minute.
Add the broth and simmer 25 to 30 minutes, until soft.
Season and finish with lemon juice.

dishes.name: Coconut Dal
steps: Start the rice.
Soften the onion, garlic and ginger in oil, then stir in the curry powder.
Add the lentils, coconut milk and two cups of water.
Simmer 25 minutes, stirring often. Salt to taste.

dishes.name: Black Bean Tacos
steps: Warm the drained beans with cumin, salt and a splash of water, mashing a few.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Slice the avocado.
Fill the tortillas with beans, avocado, salsa and cilantro. Squeeze lime over.

dishes.name: Greek Chickpea Salad
steps: Chop the cucumber and tomatoes.
Whisk the lemon juice, oil, oregano and salt.
Toss with the drained chickpeas and olives.
Crumble the feta over the top.

dishes.name: White Bean and Kale Stew
steps: Soften the chopped onion, carrot and garlic in oil.
Add the drained beans and broth and simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the chopped kale and cook 5 minutes.
Mash a few beans against the pot to thicken, then salt to taste.

dishes.name: Pesto Pasta with Peas
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water, adding the peas for the last 2 minutes.
Save a little of the water, then drain.
Toss with pesto, loosening with the water.
Top with parmesan.

dishes.name: Blistered Tomato Basil Pasta
steps: Boil the pasta and save a little of the water.
Cook the tomatoes in oil over high heat until they burst.
Add garlic and chili for 1 minute.
Toss in the pasta, basil and enough water to make a sauce.

dishes.name: Mushroom Risotto
steps: Keep the broth warm in a small pot.
Brown the mushrooms in oil and set aside, then soften the chopped onion in half the butter.
Stir in the rice for 1 minute, then add broth a ladle at a time, stirring, for about 20 minutes.
Fold in the mushrooms, parmesan and the rest of the butter.

dishes.name: Black Bean Stuffed Sweet Potatoes
steps: Prick the sweet potatoes and bake at 400°F (200°C) for 40 to 45 minutes, until soft.
Warm the beans and corn with chili powder and salt.
Split the potatoes and spoon in the filling.
Top with avocado and lime juice.

dishes.name: Grilled Cheese and Tomato Soup
steps: Heat the soup gently, following the can.
Butter the outsides of the bread and fill with cheese.
Toast in a pan for 3 minutes a side over medium heat.
Cut in half and dip.

dishes.name: Cold Sesame Noodles
steps: Cook the noodles as the pack says and rinse under cold water.
Whisk the sesame oil, soy sauce and vinegar.
Cut the cucumber into matchsticks.
Toss everything together and top with sesame seeds and green onion.

dishes.name: Weeknight Miso Ramen
steps: Boil the eggs for 7 minutes, cool and peel.
Simmer the broth with sliced mushrooms for 5 minutes.
Cook the noodles in the broth, then turn off the heat and stir in the miso and spinach.
Top with halved eggs and sliced green onion.

dishes.name: Roasted Veg Quinoa Bowl
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss chopped vegetables and drained chickpeas with half the oil, paprika and salt. Roast 25 minutes.
Cook the quinoa as the pack says.
Pile into bowls and dress with lemon juice and the rest of the oil.

dishes.name: Baked Eggplant Parmesan
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Slice and salt the eggplant, then pat it dry.
Dip the slices in flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs. Bake on oiled trays for 25 minutes.
Layer the eggplant in a dish with tomatoes, mozzarella and parmesan.
Bake 25 minutes, until bubbling, and rest for 5.
